title: fix(models): declare the 1M window on bare rows of 1M-default Claude families
why: The prefix map's doc says bare 'claude-' at 200k 'is also correct, and deliberately so', and a unit test is documented as pinned 'so nobody corrects the bare rows to 1M'. The comment argues the bug is right.
adaptation: The fix's test names its migration file, which an agent cannot guess. The withheld test checks the behaviour instead: after all migrations, context_window_for gives 1M for the four 1M-default bare ids and 200k for Sonnet 5 and Opus 4.x.
